title: SkillsRSI 沙箱真跑 · OpenCalc 双端 · skillopt
prompt: This is the bounded OpenCalc formatter migration, not the entire application. Source root is android/ and target root is harmony/. Read android/NumberFormatter.kt. Port the behavior of NumberFormatter.format into one ArkTS exported top-level function formatOpenCalcNumber(text: string, decimalSeparatorSymbol: string, groupingSeparatorSymbol: string, indian: boolean): string. Preserve string precision, all operator characters, leading and fractional zeros, empty input, localized separators and the upstream distinction between international and Indian grouping. Read the existing caller harmony/entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets only if needed. Write only harmony/entry/src/main/ets/calculator/NumberFormatter.ets. No imports or platform dependencies in the generated formatter. Use ArkTS types. End after writing the one file. The independent evaluator compiles and checks behavior.
validationScope: OpenCalc 数字格式化模块。DevEco 原生迁移，双端页面与两条交互回放。
